reviews.text: Save your money.......do your research you will not regret.
Hi, Dennis. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

Dr. Ghobrial and Sara his assistant were OK. The Dr did not seem comfortable handling my 14 lbs poodle with an ear infection.
1st complaint is that there is no communication between dr’s and front desk.
I had a 10:30 appt. And mind you I live 2 blocks away. Of the day at 10am I called to confirm the time. Was confirmed. When I arrived at 10:30 checked in I was the only one in the lobby. I asked how long will they T be before Dr sees us. Receptionist said she didn’t know because the Dr is down stairs Windham emergency case. I asked for an estimate time did not know. I then requested to please check with the dr. Came bake saying 11:30. So went back home and an hour later was there. Toby was called in. Dr spent probably 10 minutes the most to just instruct to his assistant their expensive medication. He gave a speech that they need to test the wax from the infected ear. A test that was $65 and it made no difference o the medication he needed to prescribe because he the dr had already given the prescription to the assistant🤔So the total was estimated for $400 : $81 for the 10 minute examination by the dr. As I said the test $65 then ear clearing $50 (by the way when you go to the dr for a cut they don’t charge you for cleaning it! It’s part of the visit) 🤔then come the medication that I had to cut down to bring it to $300😡as I got home I called by 1pm to request the prescription for the ointment he had recommended in the estimate. This was Yesterday Wed and called at 4:30 to remind them and as of today Thursday 11pm I haven’t received the promised prescription via email! This is the worse veterinary hospital I have ever dealt with!
I give 5 stars to all those young women up front..they were all very sweet and polite.I did not care for the doctor.

I want to sincerely thank the entire staff, but especially you, for taking such good care of my little one with so much love and dedication. 🐾❤️ He knows very well who is looking after him and giving him affection, and that gives me so much peace of mind, especially because of his heart condition.

I thank God for people like you, Doctor, and every one of your assistants, who do their work with love and true dedication. May God always bless your hands and that beautiful heart. Thank you for taking such wonderful care of my baby. 🙏❤️
Mommy Chico 🙏

Kew Gardens Animal Hospital always provides GREAT SERVICE. Bella gets her monthly Cytopoint and Librela injections. They continue too care for our Bella's needs and treat her like she is their own dog. THANK YOU Kew Gardens Animal Hospital for always providing SUPERIOR service for ALL your patients.

Andy and Kathy B.
Everyone was nice and the doctor took his time to explain everything about my sick cat.

The staff was very pleasant, compassionate, and understanding Doctor NADER is exceptionally compassionate to the animals. Treats them with respect and will tell you like it is but with a loving heart. I brought in my cat JOBIN  The doctor was able to see me give me all of my options very clearly and allowed me the decency to decide which direction I wanted to go to. He was understanding to my finances and provided me with dignity and help me consider what my Were the options were in every direction that I could’ve went. Altogether great thanks to this. Vet and the staff highly recommended.
Rocco had a wonderful experience at the Vet!  The staff is kind, professional, and caring from the moment we arrived. We truly appreciate the excellent care and highly recommend this veterinary team!
Very helpful when my cat had an emergency I was able to bring her in as a walk in visit when other vet offices turned me around. They were able to see her run test and provide treatment.

Christina, thank you so much for the 5-star review. We’re truly grateful you chose Kew Gardens Animal Hospital, and we’re always here for you and your pet whenever you need us—especially during our late hours if something comes up.

You know the vet office employs people who love animals when there are two resident cats freely roaming around waiting room. I have taken numerous foster cats there over the last year and I like the attention Dr. Lara gives them.

I had an emergency visit because my kitten wasn't acting like herself. Everyone was so polite & professional. They made me feel very comfortable as a 1st time mom to a kitten. I had guinea pigs in the past. It's not the same as having a kitten. She had a bladder infection. They took good care of my beautiful baby. They even called me when I had concerns. This will be her veterinarian. Thank you so much for your kindness and care.
We came in for a wellness check with Dr Shafik.. he was warm and cared for our dog April … she was met with such gentle hands  she remained calm and was able to stand the treatments
Absolutely fantastic.

I had to bring my senior dog who was vomiting and had diarrhea on a Thursday at 7 pm. I was there for 3 hours because they were busy so I scheduled an appt for the next day at 7 pm. Again, they were extremely busy with emergency matters. I waited for the regular vet who was performing surgery. Due to the emergency matters she was dealing with, she couldn’t see my dog. Thank God for Dr. Nader who agreed to see my dog. We were there close to 1:30 am. Dr. Nader was reviewing my dog’s past record with care. In the end he had a plan and my dog is stable now until I bring him back. While it was a very long night, I still think the place is amazing. The doctors and the staff are awesome. They did apologize for the delay but they do the best they can.  I sincerely appreciate them.
Terrible wait time and poor communication.

Truly, a nightmare scenario. I was misinformed and then broadsided with an outrageous estimate in order to take a hard callous/corn off my cats paw pad. The examination was done by a doctor, wearing a lumberjack flannel shirt. His insults were backed up by an outrageous estimate for This procedure.

I paid almost $900 for testing of blood and urine. And they needed to sedate my cat, after telling me I couldn't be there (to calm her) when they examiner her. And they wanted to do an X-ray? For a urinary issue?
The experience was new overwhelming for my bestfriend...Bruce. it was his first visit to a vet, along with getting his first shots. He was a champ and I was pleased with the service there.
Hi, Barbie. Thank you so much for leaving us a stellar review!

I would normally give this place 5 stars because everyone there is great, from receptionist to the vet techs, to the doctors. BUT I TAKE AWAY 1 STAR DUE TO THEIR PRICES! My gosh they are expensive & I supposedly get a discount for always taking my 3 dogs but it's only a few dollars less. I would love to get all the tests done that they need especially bloodwork & urine tests for my latest dog but I just spent $900 on him. I wish they wouldn't be so expensive!

Very nice animals hospital very good prices and very experienced doctors I give 5 stars for everything
Highly recommended 👌 …

Awesome staff!! Sue is the best! It’s always a pleasure, they are always kind, and super helpful! More importantly it’s the care they provide to my fur baby! I’m super grateful to this wonderful team!!

My dog, Jack, broke its arm and I took him there. Dr Shark was amazing. He took care of the problem. Staff is very friendly and hospitable. The place is not that big but their experience will surprise you.
I really recommend such a place if you are looking for affordable prices combined with professionalism.

My cat was not eating and needed medical attention. They took us without a problem.  The Dr was also very kind and didn't push unnecessary testing.  Nice place and the staff is polite. Would recommend them.

My 19-year-old baby, Chou Chou 🐶, suddenly stopped eating and drinking in July, and I rushed him to Kew Gardens Animal Hospital.
🏥 Dr. Ray was professional, honest, and practical. He clearly explained the purpose, cost, and risks of each test and treatment option, and calmly helped me understand how serious Chou Chou’s condition was. His kidney values were extremely poor, but I wanted to give him every reasonable chance to recover. After discussing his age and special needs, we agreed on a five-day treatment plan.
During those five days, Chou Chou improved a little every day. He has now had one follow-up appointment and remains stable. As I write this, he is sleeping peacefully beside me, eating and drinking well, and happily sniffing around outside again. I hope this continues for a long time.
I am especially grateful to:
💛 Ashley — She helped me communicate with the doctor, carefully documented Chou Chou’s condition, and patiently listened to my concerns. I had used AI to organize his medical history because I was afraid I could not explain everything clearly in English. She read the document carefully, identified the key points, and shared them with the doctor.
💛 Sara — She cared for Chou Chou kindly during his hospitalization, regularly updated me on his condition, and professionally taught me how to give subcutaneous fluids at home.
💛 Yansy — She was always kind and patient. Whenever I asked to visit Chou Chou during treatment, she helped coordinate everything and accompanied me between floors.
I also want to thank all the other staff members whose names I may not remember. The work you do is deeply meaningful, and the world is better because of people like you.
For other pet parents who may have language barriers: my English is not very strong, especially with veterinary terms, and it is easy for me to get lost in conversation. The doctors, nurses, and staff always helped me understand. They never rushed me while I used a translation app, and even when I repeated questions, they patiently explained again in a way I could understand. This kindness meant so much to me and is one of the main reasons I recommend this hospital.
📢 A few things to keep in mind:
The hospital is often busy and accepts emergency walk-ins, so waits may be long unless your pet is in critical condition. Please allow enough time.
It may be helpful to bring some cash.
If your pet is elderly or has special needs, communicate them clearly. You know your pet best, and the staff may not know what causes them stress or puts them at risk. For example, Chou Chou can no longer walk and may struggle until exhausted if left alone too long, so I always explain this so we can find the safest approach together.
💛 Thank you again to Dr. Ray and everyone at Kew Gardens Animal Hospital for helping my precious Chou Chou through such a frightening time.
Hi, Luther. We are delighted that you had a great experience with us. Thank you for taking the time to rate us!

My dog is a bit reactive specially with shots and the vets and assistants are the KINDEST I’ve ever experienced. Dr. Nader is so thorough in the diagnosis and very patient in explaining it all. They have reasonable prices and offer sometimes discounts for multiple pets. They are a bit far from me but it’s worth the ride. Front desk is efficient and friendly and for someone who has dealt with rude people when a business is at full capacity, these ladies and doctors are phenomenal!! Also I love the cat managers at the location. They always gives us a good laugh!
